_what: A watched test of the two features that reach a person: replying to a message with a sticker, and sending a video to a friend. Both point only at 'Iwa', which the operator has confirmed is their own other account. Never leave this on a farm phone.
_safety: allow_anyone is false and never_send_to is empty, so a video can only ever go to a name in send_to. Iwa is the only name. adiiaduu.tw (the account logged in on this phone) is NOT in send_to, so it can never be a target. A reply only fires on an UNREAD conversation whose name is in reply_to.
_precondition_reply: For the reply half to fire, the Iwa account must send a message TO this phone's account (adiiaduu.tw) first, so there is something unread to reply to.
_precondition_send: For the video half to fire, 'Iwa' must appear in the share panel's people row. It did not when probe_capture_names.js last looked; sending the message above may bring it in. If it does not appear, the script safely sends nothing.
_rates: Modest browsing rates - the point of this run is the two message features, not the counts. Watches are short so plenty of videos pass and send_to_friend gets its chances.
_seed: Off, to keep this run focused on the two message features.
_messages: On. chance_of_checking 1 so it always opens the inbox; chance_of_replying 1 so it always replies to an eligible unread. Only Iwa is eligible. One reply at most. reactions limited to Heart for a predictable result.
_send_to_friend: On, pointed only at Iwa. rate 0.5 so it tries often; max 1 so at most one video goes. allow_anyone false and never_send_to empty - a video can reach no one but Iwa.
_schedule: Off: one session, then stop, so the run can be watched from start to finish.
_ramp_up: No account_started, so the rates above are the rates that run.
